description: This file defines a C# interface for a grain in Orleans, specifying methods related to device management such as getting a serial number and setting an owner.

classes.name: IDeviceGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface representing a device, providing methods to retrieve its serial number and assign an owner.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the serial number of the device.

methods.name: SetOwner
methods.description: Assigns an owner to the device, represented by a customer grain.
